description: The Global Solar Atlas, provided by the World Bank Group and developed by Solargis, publishes long-term solar resource and photovoltaic power potential maps for the whole world. The World Bank Data Catalog entry read on 2026-09-26 describes the World PVOUT GIS data: photovoltaic power potential in kWh per kWp in the EPSG:4326 reference system, with solar resource layers (GHI, DIF, GTI, DNI) at 9 arc-seconds (about 250 m), PVOUT and air temperature at 30 arc-seconds (about 1 km) and optimum tilt at 2 arc-minutes. Values are given as long-term yearly or monthly averages of daily totals or of yearly and monthly totals, with the conversion equations stated. The world PVOUT file is a GeoTIFF of about 3.6 GB; country and regional downloads and AAIGrid versions are on the atlas download page, and each layer ships with PDF and XML metadata. The entry is classified Public and licensed CC BY 4.0; its metadata was last updated on 24 January 2023. Caveats: values are modelled long-term averages, not time series, and other resolutions are sold by Solargis. Simulation uses are siting and capacity expansion models, renewable potential screening and climate-risk studies of solar output. Related records: data-nsrdb-national-solar-radiation-database gives time series for the Americas.
